limitations: AI-reviewed development fixtures, not human ground truth, native supplier testing or gameplay qualification.
Accuracy excludes collector-unknown cases; the conservative correct/24 rate and all counts are also published.
Single attempt per arm/task; small sample, no significance or universal best-model claim.
Two corrected-distance followups replace only the affected unknown cases in the 24-case views. Original calls remain retained; all-call costs include both. Nothing else was rerun.
Whole nonstreaming tool-loop completion, not first-token or speech latency. Shared-host load and cold requests remain included.
No mandatory Jev added in this cohort. Separate eight-case Jev preselection experiment is not pooled.
Prior 9B/27B trials used different cohorts and residency; they are not ranked against these 24 tasks.
Granite poor results describe this recorded GGUF/server setup; they do not establish all Granite variants are poor.
OpenRouter Luna routes are benchmark-only. Personal permanent OpenRouter usage remains Jev-only.

Official Q4_K_M candidates, llama.cpp b12177, context 16,384, 4 CPU threads, stock Qwen resident. Prices include all model turns; local $0 is API fee only. OpenRouter Luna is test-only.
